Señor (Tales of Yankee Power)
Tim O'Brien
Red on Blonde

Standard tuning
Capo on the 3rd fret


[Intro]
[ch]Em[/ch]    [ch]Bm[/ch]
[ch]C[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D/F#[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch]
[ch]D[/ch]     [ch]C[/ch]   [ch]C/B[/ch]
[ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Em[/ch]

[Verse 1]
[tab] [ch]Em[/ch]      [ch]Bm[/ch]
Señor, Señor,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]
Can you tell me where we heading?[/tab]
[tab]               [ch]G[/ch]       [ch]D/F#[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch]
Lincoln County Road or Arma-geddon?[/tab]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                 [ch]C[/ch]    [ch]C/B[/ch]
Seems like I been down this way before[/tab]
[tab][ch]Am[/ch]                             [ch]Em[/ch]
  Is there any truth to that, Señor?[/tab]

[Verse 2]
[tab] [ch]Em[/ch]     [ch]Bm[/ch]
Señor, Señor,[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]C[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]
Do you know where she's hiding?[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]G[/ch]           [ch]D/F#[/ch]     [ch]Em[/ch]
How long are we gonna be riding?[/tab]
[tab]         [ch]D[/ch]                                [ch]C[/ch]     [ch]C/B[/ch]
How long must I keep my eyes glued to the door?[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]Am[/ch]                           [ch]Em[/ch]
Will there be any comfort there, Señor?[/tab]

[Instrumental]
[ch]Em[/ch]    [ch]Bm[/ch]
[ch]C[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D/F#[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch]
[ch]D[/ch]     [ch]C[/ch]   [ch]C/B[/ch]
[ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Em[/ch]

[Bridge 1]
[tab]          [ch]G[/ch]                                 [ch]Bm[/ch]
There's a wicked wind still blowing on that upper deck[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]C[/ch]                              [ch]Em[/ch]
There's an iron cross still hanging from around her neck[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]G[/ch]                                   [ch]Bm[/ch]
There's a marching band still playing in that vacant lot[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]C[/ch]                                [ch]Em[/ch]
Where she held me in her arms one time and said forget me not[/tab]

[Verse 3]
[tab] [ch]Em[/ch]      [ch]Bm[/ch]
Señor, Señor,[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]C[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]
I can see that painted wagon[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]G[/ch]    [ch]D/F#[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch]
Smell the tail of a dragon[/tab]
[tab]  [ch]D[/ch]                           [ch]C[/ch]    [ch]C/B[/ch]
I can't stand the suspense anymore[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]Am[/ch]                            [ch]Em[/ch]
Can you tell me who to contact here, Señor?[/tab]

[Instrumental]
[ch]Em[/ch]    [ch]Bm[/ch]
[ch]C[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D/F#[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch]
[ch]D[/ch]     [ch]C[/ch]   [ch]C/B[/ch]
[ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Em[/ch]

[Bridge 2]
[tab]          [ch]G[/ch]                              [ch]Bm[/ch]
Well, the last thing I remember before I stripped and kneeled[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]C[/ch]                                         [ch]Em[/ch]
Was a train load full of fools bogged down in a magnetic field[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]G[/ch]                              [ch]Bm[/ch]
And a gypsy with a broken flag and a flashing ring[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]C[/ch]                                       [ch]Em[/ch]
He says, "Son, this ain't a dream no more, it's a real thing"[/tab]

[Verse 4]
[tab]  [ch]Em[/ch]     [ch]Bm[/ch]
Señor, Señor,[/tab]
[tab]               [ch]C[/ch]                  [ch]G[/ch]
You know their hearts are hard as leather[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]G[/ch]              [ch]D/F#[/ch]     [ch]Em[/ch]
Give me a minute, let me get it together[/tab]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                               [ch]C[/ch]     [ch]C/B[/ch]
 I gotta pick myself up off the floor[/tab]
[tab][ch]Am[/ch]                        [ch]Em[/ch]
 I'm ready when you are, Señor[/tab]

[Instrumental]
[ch]G[/ch]    [ch]Bm[/ch]
[ch]C[/ch]    [ch]Em[/ch]
[ch]G[/ch]    [ch]Bm[/ch]
[ch]C[/ch]    [ch]Em[/ch]

[Verse 5]
[tab] [ch]Em[/ch]     [ch]Bm[/ch]
Señor, Señor,[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]G[/ch]
Let's overturn these tables[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]      [ch]D/F#[/ch]      [ch]Em[/ch]
Disconnect these cables[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]D[/ch]                               [ch]C[/ch]    [ch]C/B[/ch]
This place don't make sense to me no more[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]Am[/ch]                               [ch]Em[/ch]
Can you tell me what we're waiting for, Señor?[/tab]

[Instrumental]
([ch]Em[/ch])   [ch]Bm[/ch]
 [ch]C[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D/F#[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch]

[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                  [ch]C[/ch]    [ch]C/B[/ch]
Seems like I been down this road before[/tab]
